AirQuality.description: Air quality now. Pollutants are in µg/m³.

checked_at.description:
When the provider last sent this alert's details (`None` when unknown, as in
caches written before this change). A fetch re-requests details older than an hour
so updates reach the app while the alert lasts.

id.description:
The provider's identifier, when it has one: deduplicates alerts and lets a
later fetch reuse details it already has.

url.description:
A page with the alert's details, when the source gives one.
Caches written earlier have none.

end.description: When the alert ends, for comparing updates (shown only through `period`).

id.description:
The provider's identifier (`Alert.id`), stable while the alert lasts even when
its text changes: the key for telling alerts apart.

source.description:
Who issued it (`Alert.source`: "NWS Upton NY"); additive and optional
in plugin protocol v1, absent when the source is unnamed.

url.description:
A page with the alert's details (`Alert.url`; additive and optional in
plugin protocol v1).

AqiScale.description: Which air-quality index a value belongs to.

ClimateVm.description: A date's climate: averages, records and how often it rained or snowed.

precip_chance.description: "Rain or snow on this date in 23% of years".

CommandMsg.description: A request from the plugin to the app.

oneOf.description: Fetch now (one location, or all), within the refresh floor and call budgets.

location.description: Location index, or all when absent.

oneOf.description: Stop (when the plugin is the main display).

Condition.description:
Sky and precipitation state, normalized across WMO codes, OpenWeather ids and
MET Norway symbol codes.

apparent_max.description: The day's highest and lowest "feels like" temperatures.

period_max.description: Highest temperature of the period (display units).

period_min.description: Lowest temperature of the period (display units).

actual_high.description: The air temperature's high and low, whichever leads.

gust_max.description: The strongest gust: the day's own, else its hours' strongest.

hours.description:
Its hours, midnight to midnight as far as the forecast goes, when
`daily_hours` is set (for expanding the day).

normal_high.description: The day's normal high, when history is fetched.

outlook.description:
The day in a forecaster's words: "Cold in the morning, then sunny and
warm in the afternoon. Breezy." (with `precip_text` in it). `None`
without daytime hours.

precip_text.description:
When its precipitation falls, from its hours: "Light drizzle in the
early afternoon." `None` when dry or without hourly data.

range.description: Low and high positions in 0..=1 relative to the period's range.

timeline.description: Those hours as stretches of one kind of weather.

Degrees.description: An angle in degrees; for wind, the direction the wind blows *from*.

DetailKind.description: One card in the details widget.

trend.description:
Where the value is heading (pressure over the next three hours), for an
arrow; the caption says the same in words.

HistoryVm.description: The history widget: the last days as observed, against normal.

credit.description: Where it comes from: "NY City Central Park, 7.8 km · Normals 1991–2020".

days.description: Observed days, oldest first; days without a report show "—".

today.description: Today's normals, records and chance of precipitation.

yesterday_delta.description: "4° warmer than yesterday": today's forecast high against yesterday's.

oneOf.description: The first message: protocol version, app version and the plugin's config.
What to show, sent on every change.

snapshots.description: Raw data per location, only with `send_snapshot = true`.

view.description: The formatted view of the active location (boxed: it is large).

oneOf.description: The host is stopping; exit promptly.

dew_point.description: Dew point (from the temperature and humidity).

Hourly.description: One forecast step (1 h; 3 h for OpenWeather's free API).

now_index.description: Index of the column containing now.

timeline.description: The first 24 hours as stretches of one kind of weather (Dark Sky's bar).

IconId.description: Weather condition icons, with day and night variants where the art differs.

Intensity.description: Strength of precipitation or a storm.

Level.description: One severity scale that every display maps to colors (UV, air quality, alerts).

LocalDate.description: A calendar date in the location's local time.

LocationHeaderVm.description: The header of the shown location.

LogLevel.description: Severity of a plugin log line.

MonthToDateVm.description: Precipitation since the 1st of the month.

illumination.description: How much of the disc is lit: "62% illuminated".

rise.description: Today's moonrise with its label and instant, when the moon rises today.

NowcastTickVm.description: A label on the nowcast's time axis.

intensity.description:
How hard each step falls, 0–1 on Dark Sky's scale: a third at light
(2.5 mm an hour), two thirds at moderate (7.6), full at heavy (50).

levels.description: The scale's lines from a third up: "Light", "Moderate", "Heavy".

step_minutes.description: Minutes per step: 15, or 1 for an hour of minute data (WeatherKit).

ticks.description: Time axis labels; `step` 0 is now, `series_mm.len()` the end.

at.description: When the new offset takes effect.

departure.description: The high against normal, in display units: "+5°".

precipitation.description: Rain and melted snow; "Trace" when too little to measure.

record_high.description: The date's record high and low: "94° in 1941".

summary.description:
The day in a sentence or two: "9° warmer than normal. 0.24 in of rain."
with "A record high for the date." when it set one. `None` without a
report.

oneOf.description: A line for the app's log (stdout is the protocol channel).

PrecipHourVm.description: One hour of the precipitation table.

chance_value.description: The chance as a number, for drawing.

intensity.description: How hard it falls, 0–1 (1 at 7.6 mm an hour, heavy rain).

PrecipVm.description: The precipitation table: the next `precip_hours` hours.

dry.description:
"No precipitation in the next 12 hours." when every hour is dry (no
amount and a chance under 15%), else `None`.

hours.description: The hours, from the current one.

total.description: The amount over all of them.

oneOf.description:
The US National Weather Service (api.weather.gov): official alerts as a
supplement, and the forecast as a primary provider.

NOAA's Regional Climate Centers (data.rcc-acis.org): station history,
normals and records for US places; never a forecast.

Pirate Weather (pirateweather.net): a keyed Dark Sky-style forecast from a
blend of NOAA and other models, billed per month.

Quantity.description:
A formatted value: the number in display units (for charts and gauges), the text
to show, and the unit symbol.

text.description: The display text, e.g. "21°", "13 km/h" or the missing placeholder.

value.description: The value in display units, if known.

RadarVm.description: A radar loop's text: one label per frame, oldest first.

attribution.description: The required credit (radar source and base map).

ResolvedLocation.description: A location resolved to coordinates and a UTC offset.

station.description:
The weather station whose observation gave the current conditions
(the NWS); `None` when they are a forecast.

utc_offset.description: The location's UTC offset at fetch time.

RiseSetVm.description:
A sunrise, sunset, solar noon, moonrise or moonset: the words, the clock time and the
instant, for listing in time order and drawing on a day's bar or arc.

SkyTheme.description: The sky mood used for gradients (GUI), accents (TUI) and backgrounds (panels).

Station.description: A weather station that reported the current conditions.

distance_m.description: How far it is from the place, in metres.

observed.description:
"Observed at Central Park, 8:55 AM" when a station measured
the current conditions.

updated.description: "Updated 3 min ago", "Fetching weather…" or "No weather data yet".

SunEventVm.description: One moment of the day's light.

kind.description: Which crossing: how far the sun is below (or above) the horizon.

noon.description: Solar noon with its label and instant ("Solar noon", "1:15 PM").

progress.description: Fraction of daylight elapsed, during the day.

rise.description: Today's sunrise with its label and instant, when the place has one.

solar_noon.description: Solar noon, when the sun is highest.

sunrise.description: Sunrise time or the missing placeholder.

sunset.description: Sunset time or the missing placeholder.

twilight.description:
The day's light from dawn to dusk, in time order: astronomical,
nautical and civil dawn, the morning golden hour's end, the evening
golden hour's start, civil, nautical and astronomical dusk. Only those
the place has today (none of the deep ones in a northern summer night).

TempLevel.description: Temperature band, computed from Celsius so displays never color by display units.

TimelineGroup.description: The kind of weather a timeline stretch shows (its color).

TimelineSpanVm.description: A stretch of hours with one kind of weather.

start.description: The first hour, an index into `HourlyVm.hours`.

Trend.description: Direction of the pressure change over the next three hours.

UiIcon.description: Icons for interface elements: sun and moon events, measurements and moon phases.

UtcOffset.description: A fixed offset from UTC, in seconds east of UTC.

ViewModel.description: The display contract: everything a display shows, already formatted.

attribution.description: The required data attribution; every display shows it.

details.description: Detail cards in the configured order.

feels_like_leads.description:
Whether the temperatures that lead (the big number, the hours' and the
days' `temperature`, `high` and `low`) are feels-like ones, so displays
can say so; the air temperature is then in `actual`, `actual_high` and
`actual_low`.

history.description: The last days as observed, against normal.

is_day.description: Whether it is day at the location.

precipitation.description: The next hours' rain and snow, hour by hour.

radar.description: Radar loop labels, when imagery exists (the pixels travel beside the view).

theme.description: Sky mood for backgrounds and accents.

widgets.description: Enabled widgets with data, in the configured order.

WeatherSnapshot.description: Everything known about one location's weather from one fetch.

minutely_1.description:
Ascending one-minute precipitation steps for the next hour, from a minute
nowcast the app adds (Apple's WeatherKit on the iPhone); usually
empty.

minutely_15.description: Ascending 15-minute precipitation steps; may be empty.

models.description:
The weather models that supplied the forecast, in priority order (Open-Meteo
ids); empty when the provider chose its own.

offset_changes.description:
UTC offset changes (DST) within the forecast period, ascending; empty when
one offset (`location.utc_offset`) applies throughout.

supplemented_by.description: Providers that filled gaps; all are credited.

WidgetKind.description:
A block of information that displays can show. Displays arrange them; the order
here is the user's preferred order.

arrow.description: Arrow pointing downwind, or a space.

direction_deg.description: Direction the wind blows from, in degrees.

description: Either direction, for the combined JSON Schema.
title: whether plugin protocol v1
